title: Localization Production Workbench
objective: Build production tooling between CNI-10 and SMB-16: translation memory, term/glossary enforcement, contextual metadata, screenshots/scene/speaker references, VO linkage, stale-string detection, review states, placeholders/format QA, import/export and provider-neutral MT/AI assistance. SMB-16 remains final localization/accessibility/device completion authority.

scope.purpose: Provide localization production tooling over CNI-10 structured text context and owner-domain content while preserving SMB-16 final localization/accessibility/device completion authority and keeping MT/AI assistance provider-neutral and non-canonical.
scope.completion_gate: Representative localization content can be prepared, reviewed, checked for terminology/placeholders/staleness and deterministically imported/exported with inspectable context and VO linkage while CNI-10/owner content remains authoritative, SMB-16 retains final completion authority, provider assistance remains optional, and invalid references or format states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..12 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than silently reimplemented or weakened.
PCA-02 retained deterministic/repeatable planning authority; PCA-13 reused deterministic ordering/hash patterns without creating provider, execution, canonical mutation or publication authority.

CNI-10 retained localization-resource separation, stable text-key, source/default text, executable-behavior-invariance and locale-projection authority; PCA-13 consumed validated CNI-10 bundles and changed no source text, text identity or executable behavior.
CNI and owner domains retained canonical authored-content/state authority; translation memory, glossary, context, review and VO workbench rows did not become a parallel canonical localization ledger.
SMB-16 retained final product-wide localization/accessibility/device completion authority; PCA-13 did not declare final product localization complete.
Translation-memory staleness, glossary terms and placeholder QA remained inspectable findings only; candidate translations were not silently rewritten or approved.

MT/AI assistance remained optional and provider-neutral through explicit adapter references; PCA-13 performed no credential use, provider/network execution, paid-service operation, mandatory provider binding or automatic suggestion application.
Import/export remained deterministic stable-text-key workbench evidence with no canonical mutation, public upload, publication or release.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-13 publication. PCA-13 unlocks no new interstitial studio/rotation start; MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER. PCA-14 gates PCA-11 and PCA-12 are satisfied, so PCA-14 is the lawful next selected item.

PCA-14 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-15+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.

next_action: PCA-13 is closed. PCA-14 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
